subject: Private VPC architecture review and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>; IT Ops <it-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: Private VPC architecture review

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion and helpful context on Acme's compliance and network constraints. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Goal: Deploy Redwood Private in a VPC/on-prem configuration to meet data residency and audit requirements.
- Primary concerns: network egress restrictions, private connectivity (Direct Connect / ExpressRoute), KMS integration, and audit log retention.
- Key attendees for next meeting: your security lead & network engineer + our infra/solutions engineers.

Suggested next step: schedule a 60–75 minute Private VPC architecture review + tech deep-dive where we can walk through the proposed topology, routing options, and KMS proof points. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 8/17 — 10:00–11:15 or 15:00–16:15
- Thu 8/19 — 09:00–10:15 or 14:00–15:15

Please confirm who from your side should join (network/security/infra) and which slot works best. I attached a draft architecture brief for context (redwood-private-architecture.pdf).

If helpful, Dev will lead the deep-dive and can include a short demo of the private control plane flows.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-private-architecture.pdf
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-13T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: Private VPC architecture review

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear summary — that matches our notes. We're eager to see the architecture and validate network patterns. Our security and network leads will join: Bob Sanchez (Network) and Carol Lee (Security).

Preferred slot: Thu 8/19 14:00–15:15 PST. If that works for your team, we'll confirm and I'll loop in Bob/Carol directly.

Also — any pre-read you recommend for them? A short list of configuration prerequisites would be great.

Best,
Alice Jenkins
Head of IT Operations | Acme Corp
alice.jenkins@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: Private VPC architecture review — proposed agenda + pre-reads

Thanks, Alice — Thu 8/19 14:00–15:15 PST works for us.

Quick agenda proposal (60–75m):
1) 5m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 15m — Acme current network + constraints (Bob/Carol)
3) 25m — Redwood Private topology options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, transit) + KMS/HSM integration
4) 10m — Demo: private control plane and audit logs
5) 10–20m — Q&A, next steps & mutual action items

Pre-reads attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level milestones) and I also pasted a short list of prerequisites below:
- IP ranges available for peering / transit
- Preferred private connectivity (Direct Connect / ExpressRoute / VPN)
- KMS provider & whether HSM is required
- Expected peak qps and model sizing (rough ballpark)

Can you confirm the attendee roster (names + emails) so we can include them on the calendar invite? We'll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and a shared pre-read doc.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Sanchez <bob.sanchez@acme.com>, Carol Lee <carol.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: Private VPC architecture review — roster confirmed

Dev / Marissa,

Thanks — roster confirmed. Attendees from Acme:
- Alice Jenkins (IT Ops) — alice.jenkins@acme.com
- Bob Sanchez (Network) — bob.sanchez@acme.com
- Carol Lee (Security) — carol.lee@acme.com
- Eric Turner (Platform) — eric.turner@acme.com (optional)

We'll aim for Thu 8/19 14:00–15:15 PST. I'll share an internal network diagram as a pre-read (attached: acme-network-diagram.pdf).

One ask from Carol: can you call out any specific firewall rules or egress ports Redwood needs for the private control plane, and whether any outbound TLS inspection is compatible? A short checklist would be helpful to pass to our SOC team.

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to the architecture review.

Best,
Alice

Following up to confirm the calendar invite for Thu 8/19 14:00–15:15 PST. Agenda and pre-read links are included in the invite:

- Carol: outbound TLS inspection is generally compatible; we'll call out specific ports in the pre-read checklist (will attach PDF to the invite).

HubSpot deal: RDWD-ACME-2310 — I added the meeting to the record.

Looking forward to the review — please accept the invite and let us know if you want any additional folks invited.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
